partnershipPlan: Two women from the service's patient group review the questionnaire wording and the translated versions; a community interpreter checks that the questions work when read aloud.
socialListening: No social media listening; comments left in the service's feedback box over the past year are summarised without identifiers.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: The class was at ten on a Tuesday; with a baby and a toddler there was no way I could get there.
items.implication: Ask about childcare and preferred times directly.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I could not talk about leaking in a room full of strangers, so I never went back after the first week.
items.implication: Measure embarrassment and ask about one-to-one or online preferences.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: My sister got a letter in English and did not know it was an appointment.
items.implication: Translate the invitation and the survey and offer telephone completion with an interpreter.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: We book twelve places and six women come; the waiting list keeps growing anyway.
items.implication: Report completion as the primary outcome and first-session attendance separately.

summary: Four composite voices on childcare, embarrassment, language and empty classes.
